scope: Single-host three-JVM loopback UDP. One host/cgroup/namespace observation only; never sum it three times. Approximate UTC chooses the load window, monotonic deltas compute rates. Process/CnC samples do not establish per-order causes or one-way latency. Missing metrics remain unavailable. Approximate selection by recorded scheduledOriginUtcApproximate and each observer's UTC timestamps. No verified cross-host clock synchronization; this is not precise distributed alignment or one-way latency. Rates use monotonic deltas on the same host. cgroup/network are shared container observations. CnC counters are sequential, non-atomic reads; registration identity is preserved. Instantaneous position differences are signed observations, not exact queue/replication lag. Archive write-time includes write, configured force and descheduling elapsed time; it is not a pure fsync histogram.

cgroup.scope: Sampler's shared current leaf; quota is a visible upper bound, not dedicated CPU. Hidden ancestors are not measured. v1 under_oom/oom_kill_disable are state gauges; allocationFailures are not OOM kills.

host.networkScope: Pod network namespace/interface counters, not per-process packet loss. NoPorts counts datagrams to unbound ports; do not equate it with benchmark command loss.

node-0.ioScope: Process /proc IO accounting, not device utilization, sync latency or total physical disk traffic.
